Thermo's local formula renderer bundles MathJax 4.1.3, MathJax-TeX font data
4.1.3, referenced MathJax-NewCM data 4.1.3, and mhchemparser 4.2.1.
These packages declare the Apache License 2.0. See LICENSE and MHCHEM-LICENSE.

MathJax copyright: The MathJax Consortium and contributors.
Source: https://github.com/mathjax/MathJax-src/tree/4.1.3
Fonts: https://github.com/mathjax/MathJax-fonts
Chemistry parser: https://github.com/mhchem/mhchemParser

The bundle uses direct modules with a local LiteDOM adaptor, not a CDN loader.
Entry source and locked build dependencies: scripts/math-renderer/.
Bundled input names, versions and output checksum: CaptureMath/provenance.json.
